findings.title: DTO is public (not internal) — acceptable
findings.detail: CommonRouteDto is declared public. This matches the codebase's existing response-DTO posture (records are the frontend JSON contract) and is consistent with ListCommonRoutesResponse. Not a violation; noted only because the rule prefers internal for non-contract types.
findings.recommendation: No action. DTOs that form the HTTP contract are legitimately public.

findings.title: Handoff text says geo/suggest stays CustomerOnly; actual policy is CustomerOrStaff
findings.detail: The laneA4b handoff narrative says geo/suggest stays 'CustomerOnly'. The staged SuggestEndpoint uses Policies(nameof(AuthorizationPolicies.CustomerOrStaff)). This is a sibling-lane file, not a laneA4b deliverable, and the security point that matters for this review holds: geo/suggest is NOT AllowAnonymous. The wording mismatch is a handoff-note inaccuracy only.
findings.recommendation: No action for laneA4b. Verified geo/suggest and pricing/quote remain authenticated (not anonymous).

summary: APPROVED, blocks_merge=false. Both AC#1 blocker fixes are correct and security-safe. (1) routes/common is now AllowAnonymous and fleet-safe: ICurrentTenant injected; a 'FleetId is null -> 404' guard runs BEFORE any query; the Route entity is ITenantEntity and TaxiDbContext line 95 applies HasQueryFilter(e => e.FleetId == currentTenant.FleetId), which scopes the read for anonymous callers regardless of auth state (fleet resolved by TenantResolutionMiddleware from X-Fleet-Slug/subdomain). Tenant isolation test CommonRoutes_CrossTenant_ReturnsOwnFleetOnly seeds fleet A + fleet B routes and, via the anonymous client carrying fleet A's slug, asserts FleetBRoute is NOT returned -- a genuine A-vs-B unreachability assertion. CommonRoutes_NoFleetResolved_Returns404 protects the guard against regression. geo/suggest (CustomerOrStaff) and pricing/quote (CustomerOnly) were NOT flipped to anonymous -- confirmed. (2) No over-exposure: CommonRouteDto additive fields carry only public price-list data (route name as pickup/dropoff address, coords, zone GUIDs) -- no PII, no cross-fleet or internal fields. DropoffAddress is set only when both dropoff coords are non-null, so the downstream CreateOrder validator's 'dropoff address => dropoff coords' rule is not violated; covered by CommonRoutes_PointToPointNoDropoffCoords_OmitsDropoffAddress_StillValid and CommonRoutes_PointToPointFields_SatisfyCreateOrderValidator (TestValidate proves IsValid). (3) Migrations: laneA4b added NONE. The two staged migrations (AddFleetPrimaryColor, AddOrderRating) and the only model-snapshot deltas (PrimaryColorHex on Fleet, RatingComment/RatingStars on Order) belong to sibling UC-004 lanes; no Route column or Route snapshot change exists. (4) Rules pass: DontCatchExceptions() present, _featureConfiguration field present, Send.NotFoundAsync for the 404 guard, AsNoTracking() on the read, XML docs on endpoint + every record param (no CS1573), Europe/Prague valid-now filter preserved (static PragueZone, injected TimeProvider, day-bit + window logic intact). Two nits only, neither blocking. Did not run tests (329 green reported; web agent concurrent).
